card: Pre-flight carries its fix: `preflight --fix` repairs, re-probes, shows before->after
guard_cases: existing preflight_passes_with_a_valid_package (8 human lines), preflight_exits_non_zero_on_a_red_check (--json array of 8 HealthReport), e2e preflight_rpc_returns_eight_reports, sim_start_is_refused_while_preflight_is_red, preflight::tests pf03_verifies_without_writing_and_names_the_repair stayed green unchanged
deviations_from_card: (1) Acceptance 5 asked PF-06's guided remedy to carry `command`; no shadowrunr command writes calibration.json, so the PF-06 remedy is {kind:guided, file:<sim>/calibration.json, text} and the test asserts kind=guided + file. (2) --fix --json prints {rows:[{check,before,after,detail,remedy?,remaining?,result?}],nothing_to_fix}; plain --json keeps the HealthReport[] array. (3) A list install is only offered for a list with no installed copy and no load error (never overwrites an operator's file); categories with no known source get a guided `install-list <id> --source` remedy. (4) Daemon probe uses engine.status (cheap, spends nothing); any /rpc answer counts as a daemon. (5) docs/spec/contract.md was edited under the lock in its own commit (named in shared_surfaces, not in write_set).
notes: cargo test --workspace rc=101 only on e2e::events::live_sim_events_arrive_before_the_engine_answers (slot A's 2 s timing test) timing out under whole-workspace load; it passes alone (rc=0) and inside the full shadowrunr-daemon run (232/232). The refusal path it crosses does the same pre-flight work as before (run_all_checked replaces run_all). Flag it as timing-sensitive under load. An unrelated merge (3786dc5 character package v2) landed between my test and feature commits.
